summary: Added exact uniform-all-bitstring and uniform-feasible-portfolio sampling baselines alongside the existing QAOA distribution, with feasibility, conditional objectives, additive optimality gaps, and rejection costs. All 10 tests pass. On the synthetic six-asset instance, QAOA feasibility is 0.647346 versus 0.3125 and 1.0; its conditional gap is 0.054970 versus 0.055227 for both uniform baselines. No quantum advantage claim.
